login.title: Sign in
login.headline: See the evidence before you see the score.
login.subhead: HireLens binds a CV to a job description. The model cannot advance a stage; every number rests on a quote.
login.point1: A numeric score cannot exist without a source quote.
login.point2: No auto-accept or auto-reject. The rationale stays with the human.
login.point3: Pre-interviews are text-only. No face, voice, or emotion inference.
login.subject: User subject
login.hint: This form is local-only. On BTP, sign-in is SAP IAS/XSUAA.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Open requisitions, evidence, and human decisions on one line.
dashboard.subject: Session
dashboard.empty: No positions yet. Create the first requisition.
dashboard.jobListHint: Candidate counts, evaluation status, and quick access.
dashboard.humanOversight: AI scores; the final call always stays with the recruiter (human oversight).

tour.autoHint: The cursor advances automatically; you can also tap Next.
tour.stepFunnelBody: Open roles → candidates → evaluation → interview → decision. The numbers summarize that pipeline.
tour.stepRecentBody: Jump into Candidates for a role. Criteria weights drive JD matching.
tour.stepOversightBody: AI produces scores and evidence; shortlist/reject stays with the recruiter. No auto-hire.
tour.stepNavBody: Create and edit job postings and criteria here. The demo cursor will take you there.
tour.stepComposerBody: Set title, JD, seniority, and skills. Weights always sum to 100.
tour.stepListBody: Edit updates the JD; Candidates opens CV upload and scoring.
tour.stepCandidatesBody: Add someone to the role, select them, then the CV zone unlocks.
tour.stepUploadBody: Upload triggers parse + JD match. The evaluation screen shows evidence-backed scores.
tour.stepDoneBody: Flow: Dashboard → Position → Candidate + CV → Evaluation → Shortlist / interview. Try it yourself.

positions.title: Positions

positions.composerPromptEdit: I want to update the posting for {{title}}.
positions.composerHint: Pick seniority and skills as chips. Weights are split across the selection to 100.
positions.multiSelect: Select several, then drag to reorder.
positions.saveFailed: Save failed. Session or server error.

candidates.title: Candidates
candidates.empty: No candidates on this position yet.
candidates.selectHint: Select a candidate or add one before uploading a CV.
candidates.rankingDisclaimer: This ranking is a suggestion. The final decision is yours.

upload.title: Upload CV
upload.hint: PDF, DOCX, or plain text (max 10 MB). Bytes go to object storage; the API only sees an evidence-bound score.
upload.scanned: This document looks scanned; text could not be read. Please upload a text-based PDF.

evaluation.title: Evaluation
evaluation.noScore: No evidence, so there is no numeric score.
evaluation.coverageWarning: This score was computed with incomplete information
evaluation.awaitingCv: No evaluation yet. Upload a CV from the candidate list.
evaluation.formulaIntro: Formula: weighted average; criteria without evidence are excluded from weight.

decision.title: Decision
decision.shortlistRationale: Recruiter shortlist: evidence and scores reviewed.
decision.rationaleHint: A rationale is required. The model cannot advance the stage alone.
decision.overrideHint: You record a reasoned decision, not a new number.
